<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/146.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Página-1" id="__J-_rplvjx1_VkV20wa"> <mxGraphModel dx="1249" dy="981" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
' Diagrama de componentes/classes principais e depend�ncias
skinparam componentStyle rectangle

package \"HTTP / UI\" {
 [OperationListController] <<Controller>> 
 [OperationCsvImportController] <<Controller>> 
 [OperationReportCsvExportController] <<Controller>> 
 [OperationRunsStatusController] <<Controller>> 
 [OperationReportCsvDownloadController] <<Controller>> 
 [OperationListViewModel] <<ViewModel>>
}

package \"Jobs - Import\" {
 [ProcessOperationCsvImportJob] <<Job>>
 [ProcessOperationCsvImportChunkJob] <<Job>>
 [FinalizeOperationCsvImportRunJob] <<Job>>
}

package \"Jobs - Export\" {
 [ProcessOperationCsvExportJob] <<Job>>
 [ProcessOperationCsvExportChunkJob] <<Job>>
 [FinalizeOperationCsvExportRunJob] <<Job>>
}

package \"Import / Persist\" {
 [OperationCsvImporter] <<Service>>
 [OperationImportRowPersister] <<Persistence>>
 [OperationImportPersistenceEloquentMysqlQuery] <<Query>>
 [OperationImportRun] <<Model>>
 [OperationImportRunChunk] <<Model>>
 [OperationImportRunError] <<Model>>
 [OperationImportStagingRow] <<Model>>
}

package \"Report / Generator\" {
 [OperationCsvReportGenerator] <<Service>>
 [OperationReportRun] <<Model>>
 [OperationReportRunChunk] <<Model>>
 [OperationReportCsvQuery] <<Query>>
}

package \"Domain / Models\" {
 [Operation] <<Model>>
 [Client] <<Model>>
 [Agreement] <<Model>>
 [Installment] <<Model>>
 [OperationStatusHistory] <<Model>>
 [User] <<Model>>
}

package \"Infrastructure / Others\" {
 [OperationListQuery] <<Query>>
 [OperationImportRunLatestQuery] <<Query>>
 [OperationReportRunLatestQuery] <<Query>>
}

' Controllers -> Services / Jobs
OperationCsvImportController --> OperationCsvImporter : uses\ncreates OperationImportRun\ndispatch ProcessOperationCsvImportJob
OperationReportCsvExportController --> OperationCsvReportGenerator : uses\ncreates OperationReportRun\ndispatch ProcessOperationCsvExportJob
OperationListController --> OperationListQuery : uses
OperationListController --> OperationImportRunLatestQuery : uses
OperationListController --> OperationReportRunLatestQuery : uses
OperationListController --> OperationListViewModel : uses

' Jobs orchestration
ProcessOperationCsvImportJob --> OperationImportRun : claims + updates
ProcessOperationCsvImportJob --> OperationImportRunChunk : creates
ProcessOperationCsvImportJob --> ProcessOperationCsvImportChunkJob : dispatches
ProcessOperationCsvImportJob --> FinalizeOperationCsvImportRunJob : dispatches

ProcessOperationCsvImportChunkJob --> OperationCsvImporter : calls importWithSummary
ProcessOperationCsvImportChunkJob --> OperationImportRunChunk : updates status
ProcessOperationCsvImportChunkJob --> OperationImportRunError : writes errors
ProcessOperationCsvImportChunkJob --> OperationImportStagingRow : updates staging

FinalizeOperationCsvImportRunJob --> OperationImportRunChunk : reads chunks
FinalizeOperationCsvImportRunJob --> OperationImportRun : updates final status
FinalizeOperationCsvImportRunJob --> OperationImportFinishedNotification : creates (persist notification)

' Importer -> Persister -> DB models
OperationCsvImporter --> OperationImportRowPersister : uses
OperationImportRowPersister --> OperationImportPersistenceEloquentMysqlQuery : uses
OperationImportPersistenceEloquentMysqlQuery --> Client : upsert
OperationImportPersistenceEloquentMysqlQuery --> Agreement : upsert or create
OperationImportPersistenceEloquentMysqlQuery --> Operation : insert operations
OperationImportPersistenceEloquentMysqlQuery --> Installment : insert installments

' Export flow
ProcessOperationCsvExportJob --> OperationReportRun : claims + updates
ProcessOperationCsvExportJob --> OperationReportRunChunk : creates
ProcessOperationCsvExportJob --> ProcessOperationCsvExportChunkJob : dispatches
ProcessOperationCsvExportJob --> FinalizeOperationCsvExportRunJob : dispatches

ProcessOperationCsvExportChunkJob --> OperationCsvReportGenerator : generateChunk
OperationCsvReportGenerator --> OperationReportCsvQuery : uses cursor / operationIdCursor
OperationCsvReportGenerator --> Operation : reads relations (client, installments, agreement)
OperationCsvReportGenerator --> \"Domain services\n(PresentValueCalculator,\nOperationRateResolver)\" : uses
FinalizeOperationCsvExportRunJob --> OperationCsvReportGenerator : mergeChunkFiles
FinalizeOperationCsvExportRunJob --> OperationReportRun : updates final status
FinalizeOperationCsvExportRunJob --> OperationReportFinishedNotification : creates

' Download controller authorization
OperationReportCsvDownloadController --> OperationReportRun : checks requested_by_user_id and status
OperationReportCsvDownloadController --> \"Storage\" : returns file

' Queries and viewmodels
OperationListQuery --> Operation : reads with(client, agreement)
OperationReportCsvQuery --> Operation : reads with(client, agreement, installments)

' Models relations (simplified)
Operation --> Client : belongsTo
Operation --> Agreement : belongsTo
Operation --> Installment : hasMany
Operation --> OperationStatusHistory : hasMany
OperationImportRun --> OperationImportRunChunk : hasMany
OperationReportRun --> OperationReportRunChunk : hasMany
OperationImportRun --> OperationImportRunError : hasMany
OperationImportRun --> OperationImportStagingRow : hasMany

' Notes with file references (quick map)
note right of OperationCsvImporter
 app/Infrastructure/Import/OperationCsvImporter.php
 core: header validation, chunk plan, importWithSummary
end note

note right of OperationCsvReportGenerator
 app/Infrastructure/Report/OperationCsvReportGenerator.php
 core: buildChunkPlan, generateChunk, mergeChunkFiles
end note

note left of OperationImportRowPersister
 app/Infrastructure/Import/Persistence/OperationImportRowPersister.php
 uses OperationImportPersistenceEloquentMysqlQuery
end note

@enduml
